title: Bug screen
prompt: Full-page Bug screen in the same Mission Control style and the same top bar (with 'Bugs' active). Left column: list of bug fixes (PAY-142 'Refund rounding off by a cent' — NEEDS YOU, PAY-150 'Webhook retries duplicate charges' — WORKING, PAY-151 'Export times out' — FAILED, PAY-120 — DONE), each with key, title, status icon+word. Right: header with key + title, links (ticket, worktree path in mono with copy), cost $0.84. Pipeline strip of 8 steps (Intake, Analyze, Plan review, Implement, Diff review, Open PR, Monitor, Merge) — first two done (green check), Plan review WAITING ON YOU glowing amber, rest not reached; every step shows icon + word. 'NOW' line: 'Waiting on you: approve the plan · waiting 6m' with ticking mono timer. 'BLOCKING' panel with amber edge: 'Waiting on you: approve the plan' with Go to it, '1 question to answer before approving'. 'ASSUMPTIONS & QUESTIONS (3)': question first ('Should refunds of discounted items round up or down?', tag Analyzing, NEW chip), then assumptions ('Rounding happens only at checkout', 'Stored line items are already in cents'). Plan card rendered as four titled sections (Root cause, Fix — with file chips like src/refunds/round.ts, Test strategy, Risks) and primary 'Approve & implement', secondary 'Request changes…', danger 'Cancel'. Timeline newest first with readable stage names and relative times. Never show raw markdown.

title: First run — empty grid
prompt: The main screen for a brand-new user with no agents yet, same top bar (counters all zero, muted). Centre: a welcoming empty state that explains AgentGrid in one line ('Run several Claude Code agents side by side, and step in only when one needs you') and offers three start cards side by side, each with an icon, a title, one sentence on what happens, and a button: '+ New agent' (pick a role and a repo; it starts working on what you assign), 'Pull in a running session' (Claude Code sessions already open on this Mac — 2 found — manage them here), '🐞 Fix a bug' (turn a ticket into a merged PR, you approve each step). Below: a small 'Before you start' readiness row showing setup checks as chips — Claude Code ✓ found, Tracker ✓ claude.ai Atlassian, Forge ⚠ Bitbucket token missing (Fix it). Side panel area replaced by a short 'How AgentGrid works' panel: 3 numbered steps with micro-illustrated status glows (agents work → one needs you, it glows amber → you answer, it carries on). Keyboard hint chips in the footer.

title: New agent + Fix a bug dialogs
prompt: One canvas showing two modal dialogs side by side over the dimmed Mission Control grid. Dialog 1 'New agent': role picker as selectable cards (Coder, Reviewer, Tester, DevOps, Architect, Bug fixer), each with avatar glyph and a one-line description of what that role does and its model; repo picker with a folder field + Browse and recent repos as chips; optional first task textarea with placeholder; footer explaining 'It starts as soon as you create it; you'll be asked before any risky command.' with primary 'Create agent'. Dialog 2 'Fix a bug': step 1 pick a ticket from 'Assigned to you' list (key, title, priority chip) or paste a key; step 2 repo (auto-filled from last time for this project, with a green check 'Remote found: bitbucket.org/gruve-team/pluseai_platform'); step 3 merge policy as two explained options ('Ask me before merging' default, 'Merge automatically once approved'); a 'What happens next' strip showing the pipeline steps as small glowing dots with 'you approve the plan and the diff'; primary 'Start fixing'. Inline validation states shown (one field with a helpful error).

title: Settings
prompt: Settings as a full modal page in Mission Control style titled 'Integrations', laid out as a readiness checklist. Top: overall status 'Ready to fix bugs' or, here, '1 thing left' in amber. Section TRACKER: explanation 'Where your tickets live. AgentGrid uses the connection Claude Code already has — nothing is copied.' List of MCP servers Claude Code has, each row with name, origin in plain words ('linked to your Claude account', 'configured in Claude Code'), and 'Use this' or an IN USE cyan chip on 'claude.ai Atlassian'; preset select 'Jira'; Test button with a green inline result 'Found 12 tickets assigned to you'. Section FORGE: explanation 'Where pull requests are opened.' segmented control GitHub | Bitbucket (Bitbucket selected), Atlassian email field filled, token check row amber: 'BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN is not visible to AgentGrid — export it in your login shell, then restart' with a copyable command and Test forge button. Section REPOS: project → repo mappings as read-only rows. Each check shows icon + word + colour. Footer: Save (primary) and Close.
